title: Feature Request : Android Lockscreen Clockface
body:
Not even sure if this is possible, however a clockface showing the digital time, blood glucose value & trend/arrow much like the bgclock.html page would be really handy...

Particulatly for samsung and other devices which now have "Always on Display"

comments.body: Last time I checked the Always On Display feature is for system apps only that only Samsung can authorize. If you know any different please let me know.
Huawei p20 pro has this feature too, I wanted to implement it but didn't find information how API looks like. if someone knows something I would be interested too
Using root I think I can do it on Samsung but of course Samsung phones don't work nicely with root
@haspden Did you see #1625? That's likely want you want(ed).
